name: Playhouse
description: A timber-framed playhouse with a roofed gallery brings performances to the merchant quarter.

name: Hedge
description: A clipped hedge, painted tile by tile; neighboring hedges join into one line.

name: Garden wall
description: A low fieldstone wall, painted tile by tile; neighboring walls join into one line.

name: Ornamental tree
description: A single shade tree for a street corner or a garden.

name: Flower bed
description: A bed of summer flowers edged with stones.

name: Well
description: A stone well with a winch and a bucket, where neighbors meet.

name: Maypole
description: A ribboned maypole on a trodden green, raised every spring.

name: Pillory
description: The town's pillory: a warning to rogues and a spectacle on market days.

name: Pond
description: A still pond with reeds and a pair of ducks.

name: Fountain
description: A carved fountain that splashes in the middle of a square.

name: Statue
description: A statue of the founder on a stone plinth.

name: Cemetery
description: A walled churchyard with gravestones under old trees.

name: Square
description: Fine cobbles for a town square, painted tile by tile.

name: Harbor statue
description: A sea god in bronze greets the ships at the harbor mouth.

name: Golden statue
description: A gilded statue that tells every visitor how rich the city has become.

name: City wall
description: A stone curtain wall with a wall-walk, painted tile by tile; a road may pass through under an arch. Its defense counts once raids exist.

name: Tower
description: A round wall tower that joins a line of city wall.

name: Gatehouse
description: A gate in the city wall: wall on two opposite sides, the road through the middle.

name: Harbor tower
description: A stout tower at a pier head that watches over the harbor mouth.

name: Castle
description: A keep behind a curtain wall and a gate: the seat of the governor.

name: Repair crane
description: A treadwheel crane on the quay for ship repairs. Ship damage comes with raids; until then it stands ready.

name: Kontor
description: The company's great trading house. One per world: later it opens expeditions to new regions and the trade with other governors.
